description: This file defines an interface 'ConnectionMonitorRegistry' parameterized by a type T, which provides methods for initializing, resetting, and retrieving counters for various connection metrics and events related to messaging in the Eclipse Ditto project. It is specific to the monitoring of different connection states and message types within the connectivity messaging subsystem.

classes.name: ConnectionMonitorRegistry
classes.description: A generic interface for managing and retrieving monitors/counters for various messaging metrics associated with connections.

methods.name: initForConnection
methods.description: Initializes all monitors for the given connection.

methods.name: resetForConnection
methods.description: Resets/removes all monitors for the specified connection.

methods.name: forOutboundDispatched
methods.description: Retrieves counter for outbound dispatched messages to a target.

methods.name: forOutboundFiltered
methods.description: Retrieves counter for outbound filtered messages to a target.

methods.name: forOutboundPublished
methods.description: Retrieves counter for outbound published messages to a target.

methods.name: forOutboundDropped
methods.description: Retrieves counter for outbound dropped messages to a target.

methods.name: forOutboundAcknowledged
methods.description: Retrieves counter for outbound acknowledged messages to a target.

methods.name: forInboundConsumed
methods.description: Retrieves counter for inbound consumed messages from a source.

methods.name: forInboundMapped
methods.description: Retrieves counter for inbound mapped messages from a source.

methods.name: forInboundDropped
methods.description: Retrieves counter for inbound dropped messages from a source.

methods.name: forInboundEnforced
methods.description: Retrieves counter for inbound enforced messages from a source.

methods.name: forInboundAcknowledged
methods.description: Retrieves counter for inbound acknowledged messages from a source.

methods.name: forResponseDispatched
methods.description: Retrieves counter for dispatched response messages.

methods.name: forResponseDropped
methods.description: Retrieves counter for dropped response messages.

methods.name: forResponseMapped
methods.description: Retrieves counter for mapped response messages.

methods.name: forResponsePublished
methods.description: Retrieves counter for published response messages.

methods.name: forResponseAcknowledged
methods.description: Retrieves counter for acknowledged response messages.
